faq: How much does a turnkey office renovation in Kyiv cost?
From $350 per m². The exact amount depends on the condition of the premises, engineering and finish level — we fix it in the estimate after measuring.
Can the estimate grow during the renovation?
If we carry out the renovation to our design, we guarantee the total will not deviate from the approved estimate by more than 5%. Any extra works only with your written approval.
Can the office be renovated without stopping work?
Yes. We split the site into phases and move noisy works to evenings and weekends — the schedule is agreed with you and the business-centre management.
Do you do only renovation, or furniture too?
The full cycle: design project, renovation, engineering, furniture, lighting and decor. Furnishing comes directly from China — cheaper than buying locally.
